lede: The School Board votes Monday on a flood-damage budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money tied to this summer's hits on the TIS 5th grade pod, the high school cafeteria, and the Palm Theatre complex. Alongside that, the Ethics Commission takes up whether to establish a formal Code of Conduct for Town officials, the Hospital District board could act on a Two Site Model for the new facility, and Mountain Village's HOA moves to form a Workforce Housing Committee and vote on updated policies.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-damage budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission develops recommendation on a formal Code of Conduct for Town officials.
County discusses CCAP childcare funding and its direct budget implications.
Hospital board may act on Two Site Model, shaping what and where gets built.
TMVOA votes on updated policies and acts on workforce housing committee formation.
